## Changes

- Automatically resolve account snapshot differences at sign-in: upload a newer local copy or restore a newer cloud copy before opening the app.
- Prefer the cloud on equal or unknown timestamps. Keep device-specific 4K settings local.
- Store last-change time inside the encrypted account snapshot and retain revision checks to protect against concurrent writes.

## Important

This is whole-account last-write-wins, not a merge: older independent changes may be replaced. Enable automatic date/time on each device. Previous local edits without recorded timestamps prefer cloud data when revisions differ. Network outages can still require retry or offline access.

## Verification

180 local JVM tests passed, including the final signed-APK fixture. Release lint has no errors. Instrumentation sources compiled; physical two-device testing remains pending.

Signed 32-bit armeabi-v7a APK for Android 8.0 and newer using the existing release key. Install over the previous version without uninstalling.
